text:
maria-sales: Quick sync: NimbusHealth wants a minimal assurance bundle to unblock procurement: SOC2 control mapping excerpt, ISO certificate excerpt, signed pen-test attestation (vendor or Redwood signature), a one-page infra/network diagram, and a short embeddings dataflow. They need it early next week; procurement asked if 5 business days is feasible.

sam-eng: We can do SOC2 control mapping + auditor cover page (redacted). Full report not provided. For network diagram I can provide a single-layer diagram showing public ingress, model serving, and isolated storage. Clarify if they need Dedicated-specific notes.
maria-sales: They said "hosted prod" for the POC but procurement is thinking about Dedicated for later. For now, hosted is fine.
alex-security: Pen-test attestation: we have a standard pen-letter template (redwood-pen-attest-v2). Legal must sign; turnaround depends on Legal queue. Also note: we cannot attest to customer-specific red-team results; only to engagement completion and remediation status where applicable.
jess-legal: FYI I can review the pen-letter. If no edits, I can sign within 2 business days. If vendor signature required (third-party pentest firm), that adds time. Who is the pen-test vendor on our last engagement?
alex-security: Last engagement was with SecProbe LLC; they provide an attestation we can include if the customer wants vendor-signed. Ops requires a signed NDA before sharing any raw findings.
lena-ps: For the embeddings dataflow I will prepare a short paragraph: where embeddings are created (inference runtime), what metadata is stored (no raw user message retention by default), and where ephemeral caches live. I'll flag that PHI/PII is not persisted unless configured. Also note presigned upload TTL: default 24h; extended TTLs need OPS ticket.
maria-sales: Procurement also asked about audit log retention for 12 months and pricing impact. Can we give them a ballpark?
sam-eng: Audit log retention extension requires storage + compliance handling. For hosted customers, 30 days is default; 12 months is possible with a retention surcharge. Estimate delta: $0.02 per GB-month storage + $500 one-time export setup fee if they request historic logs. I'll defer to finance for exact pricing.
jess-legal: Also confirm whether customer needs KMS attestation. We can state that keys are managed by Redwood with strict access controls for hosted; Dedicated customers can bring their own KMS. If they need an attestation letter about KMS separation, Legal+Security will need 3-4 business days.
op-bot: Created ticket OPS-1342: Extended presigned TTL and audit-export request. Owner: @lena-ps.
lena-ps: I will own OPS-1342. Maria, can you confirm CISO contact and whether redacted logs suffice? Once confirmed I can assemble: control mapping csv, ISO cert excerpt screenshot, one-page diagram (PNG), embeddings-dataflow paragraph, and pen-letter draft (unsigned). ETA: end of day Monday if we get approval today.
maria-sales: I'll get CISO contact and confirm redaction. Pushing customer to accept Monday EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:
